closed_orders.path_set_order: frozen report or label order when emitted; set formulas ignore order

formulas.reviewer_set: For a selection outcome, R is the set of selected paths in strongest-to-weakest order. For Unknown, R is undefined.
formulas.prediction_set: P is the exact frozen D.2A important-file prediction set for the case.
formulas.label_set: L is the exact frozen important-file label set for the case.
formulas.origin_consensus: candidate is in P and in L
formulas.origin_prediction_only: candidate is in P and not in L
formulas.origin_label_only: candidate is in L and not in P
formulas.symmetric_difference_distance: |R symmetric-difference X| = |R minus X| + |X minus R|
formulas.exact_set_match: R and X contain exactly the same path strings
formulas.aggregate_reviewer_path_agreement: Across selection-outcome cases only, sum intersections, unions, and symmetric-difference distances separately for P and L. Jaccard reviewer agreement is summed intersection divided by summed union.
formulas.aggregate_empty_union: If the summed union is zero, Jaccard reviewer agreement is 1; otherwise it is rounded deterministically to six decimal places.
formulas.selection_size_distribution: Counts selection outcomes only at sizes zero through five; Unknown is counted separately.
formulas.unselected: A union candidate absent from R in a selection-outcome case.
formulas.unknown_candidate_status: Every candidate in an Unknown case is not-judged-unknown, never unselected and never a negative judgment.

predeclared_analysis: selected, unselected, and not-judged-unknown candidate counts by origin
per-case intersections with frozen prediction and label sets
per-case symmetric-difference distances to frozen prediction and label sets
exact-set matches to prediction and label sets
aggregate reviewer path agreement with prediction and label sets
comparative selection status by prior D.2C item disposition for disputed candidates
selected, unselected, and not-judged-unknown counts for every prior disposition including defensible, unsupported, and Unknown
complete case-level and candidate-level mechanical mapping
explicit non-negative handling of reviewer Unknown cases
no recalculation or replacement of official frozen scores, labels, or release gates
